_help: GLOBAL SETTINGS — shared by every page. Edit the values, keep the keys. Images resolve against media.* folders below: a bare name like 'shop.jpg' becomes 'assets/img/shop.jpg'; a path starting with 'assets/' or 'http' is used as-is. Leave a media value as "" to fall back to generated artwork.

brand.name: The Leather Store
brand.description: The Leather Store is a family-run boutique in Anantapur offering handpicked leather shoes, sandals, sneakers, sunglasses, wrist watches, handbags, wallets, travel bags and fine fragrances.

map._help: lat/lng place the pin on the map. directionsUrl is the Google Maps link used by every 'Get directions' button — paste a share link from Google Maps to change it.

hours._help: Each day lists its open windows as "HH:MM-HH:MM" in 24-hour time. Add a second entry for a lunch break, or use [] for a closed day.

owner.name: Abdul Aziz
bio: Long before there was a shop, there was an eye for it. {NAME} was the boy who could spot good stitching across a room, who knew what people would be wearing a season before they did. In {ESTABLISHED} he finally gave that instinct an address, and {STORE} opened its doors in {CITY}.

He still does the buying himself. Every article on these shelves is chosen by hand — read the market, follow the trend, then go looking for the piece nobody else bothered to find. Rare collections and handpicked finds, never a bulk order off a catalogue.
That is the whole promise. If it is not something he would wear or carry himself, it does not reach the shop floor. Walk in, take your time, ask him anything — he genuinely enjoys the conversation.
